questions.question: 105 is related to 20.9 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 175 is related to 34.9. To which of the following is 215 related, following the same logic?(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

Six boxes, A, B, C, D, E and F, are kept one over the other, but not necessarily in the same order. D is kept third from the bottom. Only one box is kept between D and A. Only two boxes are kept between D and E. B is kept immediately below E. C is kept immediately above A. Only one box is kept between F and E.Which box is kept second from the top?

F, J, M, L, R, V and X are seated around a circular table facing the center. Only one person is seated between X and M, when counted from the right of X. Only one person is seated between M and V. Only one person is seated between X and J. Only two people are seated between L and V. Only one person is seated between R and J. How many people are seated between X and F when counted from the left of F?

Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V attends a seminar on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.  A attends on Wednesday. Only one person attends between A and C. D attends immediately before C but not on Monday. There are exactly two people between D and F. G’s seminar is before E’s but after B’s. B attends the seminar on Monday.On which day does G attend the seminar?
Looking at a man in the photo, Mrs. Sen said, "He is the husband of the daughter of my husband's father's only son." How is the man related to Mrs. Sen?

Refer to the following letter series and answer the question.Counting to be done from left to right only.(Left) K  R  H  V  K  N  Z  A  N  F  X  S  O  X  G  A  K  J  O  L  A  (Right)How many such consonants are there each of which is immediately preceded by a vowel and also immediately followed by a consonant?2820
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (More than two) है।

In a certain code language,A+ B means ‘A is the son of B’A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’A @ B means ‘A is the wife of B’A % B means ‘ A is the father of B’Based on the above, how is C related to B if ‘C+A%S@E–B ’?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Brother's wife's brother) है।

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Son's wife's father) है।
